baseCohortDefinition.name: Female patients with maternity encounters between dates

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e INNER JOIN person p ON e.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'a9f11592-22e7-45fc-904d-dfe24cb1fc67') AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND e.voided = 0
